title: Maine Revised Statutes Title 26, Chapter 7, Subchapter 2 - Wages and Medium of Payment
verified_how: Fetched title26ch0sec0.html (prints 'Title 26: Labor and Industry' with chapter 7 'Employment Practices') and title26ch7sec0.html, which prints 'Title 26, Chapter 7: EMPLOYMENT PRACTICES' and, under 'Subchapter 2: Wages and Medium of Payment', live sections 26 §621-A Timely and full payment of wages, §628 Equal pay, §628-A Compensation history inquiry prohibited, §629-A Fringe benefits, §632-A Fund for recovered wages, §639-A Minimum pay for reporting. Page states 'Data for this page extracted on 10/20/2025 14:32:56'; the Titles index gives the text as current through October 1, 2025 (First Special Session, 132nd Legislature).
notes: Minimum wage and overtime are in the adjacent Subchapter 3 (Minimum Wages, 26 M.R.S. §§ 661-672, with the minimum wage at §664), so an encoding of Maine pay law should take subchapters 2 and 3 of the same chapter together.
